title: T155 Chromium dry-run cannot run as given: dry.spec.ts under node_modules is not type-stripped
description: Found by V (T151). npx playwright test -c node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui3-nativefix/dry.config.mjs exits 1: Stripping types is currently unsupported for files under node_modules; No tests found (log node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui3-final/step4b-t155-dry.log). Harness only, not a product failure. A copy with the 6 type annotations removed (node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui3-final/t155/dry.spec.mjs) passes 1/1 on both the final dist and ui3-p2/dist (step4b-t155-dry-final.log, step4b-t155-dry-p2.log). Fix: rename dry.spec.ts to .mjs without annotations, or update NATIVE-GATE-MORNING.md to point at the ui3-final/t155 configs.

review.note: Checked: dry.config.mjs runs the type-free dry.spec.mjs (testDir is ui3-nativefix; default testMatch picks up only the .mjs, the .ts.old is not matched). Diff vs dry.spec.ts.old shows only the removed type annotations, assertions identical. t160-dry.log shows 1 passed and is newer (06:55) than the spec (06:54), test path in log is dry.spec.mjs. NATIVE-GATE-MORNING.md command matches the config exactly and the pinned node binary exists. Note: the config names no spec file explicitly, so it depends on testMatch; fine as is.
